name: python-run-length
title: Run-Length Pair Counter
blurb: Run-length over lowercase text: decode hands back the letters encode was sent on shipped and seeded corpora, encode answers exactly what the shipped stepper walks, and a repeat never costs more pairs than letters.
default_description: A run-length counter whose stream folds back to the letters it was sent on any text, and whose pairs answer exactly the runs the stepper walked.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a run is walked once and answered as a pair
